record.bridgyOriginalText: You know what is the saddest thing about the rise of LLM/GenerativeAI? That it, and the frequently (but not always) poor quality output it generates, have become the public perception of AI. All the incredible breakthroughs in Machine Learning, which has been transformative in many areas, is tarred with the brush of AI slop…. I also think all the resources being used on GAI/LLM are ultimately wasted as the limits of the technology are becoming clear…
